subject: Request: Security assessment report and GRC upload instructions
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acmecloud.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Security assessment report and GRC upload details
Attachments: Acme_GRC_questionnaire_v3.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Vanessa / Rachel,

Thanks for the quick intro yesterday. Procurement and our security/compliance team need the latest security assessment artifacts to complete AcmeCloud's vendor onboarding. Specifically: 

- The most recent penetration test or security assessment report (signed if available).
- A remediation tracker that maps findings to status and ETA.
- Completed SIG/CAIQ sections in the attached spreadsheet (we pre-filled some items).

Our GRC portal requires the pen test report to be uploaded as a PDF and tagged to the vendor record (see portal link below). Can you confirm: 
1) Whether Redwood can provide a redacted copy that removes customer-identifiable data?
2) If you can also provide a short remediation summary (one page) for any open high/critical items.
3) Target delivery date — we need materials ingested by 2026-03-26 to stay on our timeline.

Portal link (for upload): https://grc.securecorp.com/portal/upload/ACME-570

If you prefer, you can also send artifacts to grc@securecorp.com and we will upload on your behalf.

Appreciate it — please loop in security folks if helpful.

Alex Turner
Sr. Procurement Manager, AcmeCloud
alex.turner@acmecloud.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Security assessment report and GRC upload details
Attachments: redaction_policy.pdf (application/pdf)

Alex — thanks for the clarity and the spreadsheet. Looping in Monica (CS) and Markus (Security & Compliance) to help with artifacts. Quick answers up front:

1) Redaction: Yes — we can provide a redacted PDF of the most recent third-party penetration test. Our standard practice is to remove any customer-identifying artifacts and live IPs; see attached redaction_policy.pdf for details on what we redact.

2) Remediation summary: We will provide a remediation tracker and a one-page summary for any items with severity High or Critical.

3) Timeline: We can get the redacted pen-test report + remediation summary to you by 2026-03-24. If AcmeCloud needs portal ingestion by 2026-03-26, that gives us a small buffer. If you require an attested/signed copy with a third-party stamp, let us know — that may add 3–5 business days.

Portal/upload questions: Do you require filenames to follow a specific convention? Also, are you OK with us uploading directly via the portal, or would you prefer we email the files to grc@securecorp.com and you perform the upload?

We will also provide the completed SIG sections requested, but note some fields are internal process notes — Markus will propose appropriate redactions/explanations where necessary.

Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: GRC Portal <grc@securecorp.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Security assessment report and GRC upload details
Attachments: upload_instructions.pdf (application/pdf); portal_token.txt (text/plain)

Hi Vanessa / Rachel,

Thanks for the note. Portal team here — we can accept either a direct upload or an inbound email to grc@securecorp.com. A few important items: 

- File types: PDF (for reports), XLSX/CSV (for remediation trackers), TXT/PDF for attestations.
- Filenames must follow: ACME_ProviderName_DocumentType_vYYYYMMDD (e.g., ACME_Redwood_PenTest_v20260324.pdf).
- Please include a one-line description in the portal "Notes" field indicating whether the report is redacted.
- Portal accepts up to 250MB. If you are uploading on behalf of Redwood, please use the token attached (portal_token.txt) in the upload flow to tag the files to the AcmeCloud vendor record.

If you email artifacts to grc@securecorp.com, include the same filename convention in the subject line.

We will confirm ingestion and send a record ID once processed.

Best,
GRC Portal Operations
grc@securecorp.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Security assessment report and GRC upload details
Attachments: redacted-pen-test-report-v1.2.pdf (application/pdf); remediation_tracker.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Alex — we uploaded the required artifacts to AcmeCloud's GRC portal this afternoon as requested. Details below: 

- Pen test report: ACME_Redwood_PenTest_v20260322.pdf (redacted, third-party assessor signature retained) — uploaded via portal (used token). File in portal now.
- Remediation tracker: ACME_Redwood_RemediationTracker_v20260322.xlsx — includes mapping, owner, status, and ETA for open findings.
- One-page summary: included as the first sheet in the tracker and also attached here.

Portal upload record ID: GRC-ACME-000782 (portal confirmed ingestion at 16:05 PST).

Notes: Two findings remain open at severity High — remediation ETAs are 2026-04-08 and 2026-04-15 respectively. Markus has review ownership and will follow up with your security team if you want more technical details.

Next steps:
- Monica will schedule a short walk-through next week to review the remediation tracker and validate closure criteria.
- Markus will share any non-redactable artifacts under an NDA if needed for deeper technical validation.

If you want us to attach a signed attestation (wet signature) for internal procurement, we can initiate that next week.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123
